def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),int)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); pX[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Y[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); pY[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            t=(M[i-1,j-1],X[i-1,j-1],Y[i-1,j-1]); M[i,j]=max(t)+sc(s1[i-1],s2[j-1]); pM[i,j]=int(np.argmax(t))
            a,b=M[i-1,j]+go,X[i-1,j]+ge; X[i,j]=max(a,b); pX[i,j]=0 if a>=b else 1
            a,b=M[i,j-1]+go,Y[i,j-1]+ge; Y[i,j]=max(a,b); pY[i,j]=0 if a>=b else 2
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]])); a1=[];a2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append(s2[j-1]); st=pM[i,j]; i-=1;j-=1
        elif st==1: a1.append(s1[i-1]);a2.append('-'); st=pX[i,j]; i-=1
        else: a1.append('-');a2.append(s2[j-1]); st=pY[i,j]; j-=1
    return "".join(a1[::-1]),"".join(a2[::-1])

            a,b=f["location"]["start"]["value"],f["location"]["end"]["value"]; h=s[a-1:b]
            if 60<=len(h)<=70 and set(h)<=set(AA): bg.append((g,h))

for g,h in bg:

M=np.array(mat); names=np.array(names)

def fa(a):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60,headers=H).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])
HD2=fa("Q6IQ32")[1042:1102]; HD1=fa("Q9H2P0")[755:815]
cons={};freq={}
for p in range(1,61):
    col=[c for c in M[:,p-1] if c!='-']; cnt=Counter(col); n=len(col)
    cons[p]=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; freq[p]={a:cnt.get(a,0)/n for a in AA}
BASE=[3,5,47,50,51,54]; BBONE=[25,28,31,53,55,57]; CORE=[16,20,38,40,45,48,49]
bgf={'A':.074,'R':.052,'N':.045,'D':.054,'C':.025,'Q':.034,'E':.054,'G':.074,'H':.026,'I':.068,
     'L':.099,'K':.058,'M':.025,'F':.047,'P':.039,'S':.057,'T':.051,'W':.013,'Y':.032,'V':.073}
n0=len(M)
def surf(s,poss,alpha=5.0):
    t=0
    for p in poss:
        a=s[p-1]
        if a in AA:
            f=(freq[p][a]*n0+alpha*bgf[a])/(n0+alpha); t+=np.log2(f/bgf[a])
    return t

def search(q,size=80):
    return requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
      params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,gene_primary,organism_name,sequence","format":"json","size":size},
      timeout=120,headers=H).json()["results"]
def bestw(seq,ref):
    best=(-1e9,None)
    for i in range(len(seq)-len(ref)+1):
        w=seq[i:i+len(ref)]; s=sum(sc(a,b) for a,b in zip(w,ref))
        if s>best[0]: best=(s,w)
    return best[1]

for tag,ref in [("ADNP2",HD2),("ADNP",HD1)]:
    ws=[]
    for e in search(f"(gene:{tag}) AND (length:[900 TO 1400])"):

        s=e["sequence"]["value"]
        if g.upper()!=tag or not set(s)<=set(AA): continue
        w=bestw(s,ref)
        if sum(1 for a,b in zip(w,ref) if a==b)/60>0.55: ws.append(w)
    orth[tag]=list(dict.fromkeys(ws))
shown=[3,5,31,47,48,50,51,53,54,55]
